NY Times Article: Escape to Bro-topia

It's about a guy who was living in New York and doing well financially, but left it behind to have a simpler life in a secluded area in Washington state. I think it's a good MGTOW story, but without the MGTOW label. The guy in the story realized that the rat race of the city wasn't going to make him happy, although he does still work as a photographer and a consultant.

Of course, there's the usual condescension that we've come to expect from the mainstream media. The title, "bro-topia" is obviously meant as a put down. His particular method of going his own way involves a treehouse and a skate bowl, so of course, that means he's immature, right? Bullshit. I think he's got life figured out.

Anyway, thought some people here might enjoy it.
